steps.tx: Kill the druid Ursangous here. Ashenvale (39.2, 65.1) He is in bear form and patrols a little(see Questie-Worldmap for this) CAREFUL there is a GIANT Elite nightelf Tree patrolling around here too.

Careful you will get ambushed by 4 Nightelves in the building. This can be soloed as they dont have "normal hp" in comparison. But use all cooldowns you have+Potions if need be.
